Isha P (SE): opening ZenithBank POC thread — customer requires BYO HSM (Thales Luna preferred) for envelope encryption of model artifacts + runtime unwraps. New asks: FIPS140-3 attestation, offline PKCS#11 import for initial key ceremony, rotation cadence <=4h for ephemeral session KEKs, and signed provenance for every wrap/unwrap. They also want a capped monthly cost option for very high QPS.
Marc V (AE): pricing clarity: can we offer (A) per-op billing (wrap/unwrap) + monthly proxy fee, or (B) prepaid blocks with volume discounts and a hard cap? Customer wants predictable billing for heavy inference spikes.
Isha P (SE): we can offer both. Suggestion: prepaid block + burst overage at reduced per-op rate. For on-prem full private deployment we convert to fixed monthly fee + PS. I'll draft numbers.
Dana Q (Security): SQ items: vendor attestation (signed cert), FIPS140-3 statement, SOC2 artifacts, and proof Redwood never holds unwrapped KEKs. They want key-escrow option with neutral third party (escrow only holds wrapped KEK). Is that supported?
Omar L (SRE): escrow: yes — we can generate a wrapped KEK and escrow the wrapped blob to a named escrow provider. Redwood will never receive unwrapped material. We can provide verification hashes and an attestation workflow for the customer to validate escrow contents. Latency: wrap/unwrap ~5-35ms depending on HSM and region; add ~6-12ms for proxy hop. We'll include measured p50/p95 p99 from Dedicated pool.
Bea (Deal Ops): quote flavors requested: 1) Managed key-proxy in customer VPC (we operate proxy), 2) Private on-prem package. Add PS for offline ceremony facilitation (8-16h), PKCS#11 import checklist, and optional 24/7 on-call. Also include escrow facilitation as add-on.
Marc V (AE): legal asked: indemnity for BYOK and escrow liability. We'll push standard BYOK clause (customer retains custody risk) and escrow facilitation language (we're a facilitator, not custodian). Flag legal for negotiation.
Isha P (SE): we support signed provenance events and can HMAC-sign audit events before forwarding. We can stream to Splunk HEC / Datadog / S3 with envelope signing. Sample bind snippet for docs:
``` 
redwoodctl kms bind --mode byo \
  --pkcs11-module /usr/lib/luna/pkcs11.so \
  --key-slot 2 --key-label "zenith-proc-1" \
  --proxy https://key-proxy.zenith.example --mtls-cert /etc/zenith.pem
```
And a PKCS#11 import example:
```
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/luna/pkcs11.so --login --write-object wrapped_kek.bin --type generic-secret --label "wrapped-keK"
```
Dana Q (Security): split-custody ask: they want a neutral third-party escrow + two-person ceremony for initial import. Redwood will orchestrate but not hold raw shards, correct?
Omar L (SRE): correct. Redwood can orchestrate verification and accept the wrapped KEK only. We'll publish the verification hash and provide step-by-step dry-run docs.
Marc V (AE): acceptance criteria for POC: 1) E2E encrypt/decrypt using customer KEK, 2) rotation at target cadence with zero dropped requests, 3) 95p end-to-end gen latency <=180ms, 4) provenance and key-op audit stream delivered and signed, 5) cost model validated under 1M ops/day.
Bea (Deal Ops): I'll produce two-variant quote with prepaid block option + PS lines and escrow facilitation add-on. Will attach sample SOW bullets and runbook.
redwood-artifact-bot: uploaded artifact: zenith-poc/attestation_and_runbook.zip
Isha P (SE): thanks all — syncing with finance/legal for per-op bands and liability language. Will follow up in 24h. :white_check_mark:
